subject: Create Gemini client wrapper (src/engine/gemini-client.ts) + tests
description:
Create `src/engine/gemini-client.ts` with:
- `EditImageResult` interface (imageBuffer, responseText, observability fields)
- `DEFAULT_GEMINI_CONFIG` constant (model: gemini-2.5-flash-image)
- `GeminiClient` class:
  - constructor(apiKey?) — creates GoogleGenAI instance, passes apiKey only when provided
  - `editImage(imageInput, prompt, config?)` — handles Buffer or file path input, base64 encodes, calls generateContent with responseModalities ["TEXT", "IMAGE"], optional imageConfig/seed, extracts image buffer and text from response, captures observability fields (responseId, modelVersion, usageMetadata, finishReason)
  - `detectMimeType(buffer)` — private, checks magic bytes for PNG/JPEG/WebP

Also create `tests/engine/gemini-client.test.ts` with:
- Test detectMimeType via editImage with mocked SDK
- Test that missing image in response throws error

Depends on: types.ts (Task #2)
activeForm: Creating Gemini client wrapper and tests
